create_F2_regularizer: create an F2 regularizer instance with a lambda coefficient for L2 penalty computation
create_N3_regularizer: create an N3 regularizer instance with a lambda coefficient for L3 penalty computation
compute_F2_penalty: compute the normalized L2 penalty and raw sum of squared factors using F2
compute_N3_penalty: compute the normalized L3 penalty and raw sum of cubed absolute factors using N3
checkpoint_regularizer: save the regularizer state dictionary to a file path at a given epoch
